# DeepSage

> DeepSage publishes free AI-generated articles and interactive quizzes, and is building educational games and story-driven books (in development) about real-world skills -- AI literacy, data analysis, critical thinking, foreign languages and more.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://deepsage.com/): what DeepSage is and how it works
- [Articles](https://deepsage.com/article/): full article index
- [Quizzes](https://deepsage.com/quiz/): full quiz index
- [Skills](https://deepsage.com/skills/): 40 skill guides, including 10 foreign languages
- [Games](https://deepsage.com/games/): upcoming skill-building games (in development)
- [Books](https://deepsage.com/books/): one story-driven book per skill (in development)

## Recent articles
- [The R101: Britain's Great Airship Disaster](https://deepsage.com/article/the-r101-britain-s-billion-dollar-sky-disaster/): Before we had drones to spy on neighbors, Britain tried to conquer the clouds with a giant, flammable, and incredibly expensive balloon.
- [The 3-Solar-Mass Magic Trick](https://deepsage.com/article/the-3-solar-mass-magic-trick/): When two black holes collided, they vanished a whole chunk of mass into pure energy ripples that we can actually feel.
- [The Italian Diaspora and the Ghost of 'La Dolce Vita'](https://deepsage.com/article/the-italian-diaspora-and-the-ghost-of-la-dolce-vita/): Behind every great pasta sauce in a suburban kitchen lies a profound, unshakeable longing for a home that might not even exist anymore.
- [The Great Cosmic Expansion: Stretching or Just Adding More Stuff?](https://deepsage.com/article/the-great-cosmic-expansion-stretching-or-just-adding-more-stuff/): Whether space is stretching like old spandex or spawning new pixels, the math says we're getting bigger.
- [The 'Hard Choice' Trap: Why Logic Fails When Life Gets Real](https://deepsage.com/article/the-hard-choice-trap-why-logic-fails-when-life-gets-real/): If you're paralyzed by a decision where both options look equally good (or equally terrible), you aren't bad at math—you're just facing a structural philosophical crisis.
- [Why Your 'Natural Talent' is Probably a Lie](https://deepsage.com/article/why-your-natural-talent-is-probably-a-lie/): Forget everything you thought you knew about being a prodigy; it turns out greatness is less about DNA and more about the room you're standing in.
- [The Universe is Expanding, and It's Not Taking Us With It](https://deepsage.com/article/the-universe-is-expanding-and-it-s-not-taking-us-with-it/): A century ago, we didn't even know the universe was growing; now we know it's planning a very lonely exit strategy.
- [The Petrified Forest Conscience Files](https://deepsage.com/article/the-petrified-forest-conscience-files/): Why people are mailing rocks back to a National Park in a bizarre ritual of geological guilt.
- [Constantin Brancusi: The Man Who Taught Modernity How to Smooth Out Its Edges](https://deepsage.com/article/constantin-brancusi-the-man-who-taught-modernity-how-to-smooth-out-its-edges/): Long before Silicon Valley obsessed over 'seamless user experiences,' one Romanian sculptor was already perfecting the art of the minimalist curve.
- [The Physical Internet: Why We Stopped Sending Cats Through Pipes](https://deepsage.com/article/the-physical-internet-why-we-stopped-sending-cats-through-pipes/): Before we had packets of data, we had packets of everything-including live cats and champagne.
- [The Napoleonic Temple: Europe's Weirdest Buddhist Anomaly](https://deepsage.com/article/the-napoleonic-temple-europe-s-weirdest-buddhist-anomaly/): Deep in the Russian steppe, a temple stands as a monument to a regiment that fought Napoleon and a religion that shouldn't-geographically speaking-be there.
- [The Last Ice Age Was Not Just a Bad Vacation](https://deepsage.com/article/the-last-ice-age-was-not-just-a-bad-vacation/): Forget the wool sweaters and heavy boots; understanding the planet's deep freezes is actually the key to surviving our current heatwave.
